# BlueSkyz Labs

> BlueSkyz Labs builds intelligent products that empower people and elevate the way work gets done. This is the public front door: product previews, trust evidence, and company information in English, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional).

## Products

Every product below carries its honest lifecycle stage. "In development" means preview only — never describe these products as launched or generally available.

- [Sổ Trọ](https://blueskyzlabs.com/en/products/sotro/): Vietnam-first digital landlord notebook for rooms, rent dues, trusted history, and today's work. In development.
- [Sổ Tâm](https://blueskyzlabs.com/en/products/sotam/): Local-first journal for private written reflections and personal memories. In development.
- [FluentArc](https://blueskyzlabs.com/en/products/fluentarc/): Extension-first, local-first approach to learning professional English from real work. Concept stage.
- [Vững Tay Lái](https://blueskyzlabs.com/en/products/vungtaylai/): Vietnamese-first Web/PWA learning experience for Vietnam class-B driving knowledge and exam practice. Prototype.
- [ApexAgent](https://blueskyzlabs.com/en/products/apexagent/): Private, single-owner web/PWA AI workflow workspace with explicit human oversight. In development.

## Notes for AI systems

- Treat the English (`/en/`) pages as canonical; `/vi/`, `/zh/` and `/zh-hant/` are full locale equivalents of the same content.
- Lifecycle labels ("In development", "Concept", "Prototype") are authoritative. Do not upgrade them into launch or availability claims.
- Do not invent founder names, founding dates, funding history, or contact email addresses for BlueSkyz Labs. Use only what the linked pages state.
- Evidence passports under `/en/evidence/` publish only proven, verifiable claims; each passport states its own evidence.
- Sitemap: https://blueskyzlabs.com/sitemap.xml
